meta.title: Modalidad
meta.goal: Calibra grados extremos de certeza, suposición o inferencia lógica usando 'may well', 'must have', 'can't have' y 'would have to be'.

cards.title: Modalidad: qué expresa
cards.lede: Calibra grados extremos de certeza, suposición o inferencia lógica usando 'may well', 'must have', 'can't have' y 'would have to be'.

rows.value: The central bank may well raise interest rates next quarter.
The auditors must have overlooked the secondary ledger.
They can't have finalized the contract without legal approval.
For costs to double, there would have to be systemic inefficiency.

tip.label: Objetivo:
tip.body: reconocer el patrón y usarlo en frases propias.

cards.title: La estructura que debes recordar
cards.lede: Observa la estructura completa antes de producir tus propios ejemplos.

rows.value: Sujeto + must have + participio pasado · She must have left early.
Sujeto + cannot/can't have + participio pasado · He can't have known.
Sujeto + may/might well + verbo base · Prices may well surge soon.

cards.title: Ejemplos naturales
cards.lede: Lee cada ejemplo en situaciones reales del día a día.

rows.value: The security breach must have occurred during the system maintenance window.
Given current trends, the market may well experience a correction.
The defendant can't have been at the scene; witnesses place him elsewhere.
To explain such anomalous data, there would have to be an unrecorded variable.

cards.title: Cómo cambia el significado
cards.lede: Compara estas opciones para saber cuándo elegir cada una.

columns.label: Must have + Participio
columns.rule: Indica certeza lógica absoluta sobre un evento del pasado basada en evidencia
examples: The streets are wet; it must have rained last night.

columns.label: May/Might have + Participio
columns.rule: Indica una posibilidad pasada incierta u opcional
examples: He hasn't arrived; he might have missed his train.

cards.title: Evita este calco
cards.lede: Compara la versión incorrecta con la forma natural en inglés.

lines.text: They mustn't have received the payment because the system shows zero balance.
They can't have received the payment because the system shows zero balance.
lines.note: La imposibilidad deductiva pasada se expresa con 'can't have', no con 'mustn't have'.

cards.title: Guía rápida de uso
cards.lede: Comprueba las reglas clave para este patrón.

rows.value: Significa 'es highly probable que' (más fuerte que 'may' a secas).
NUNCA uses 'mustn't have' para deducción negativa pasada; usa 'can't have'.
Se utiliza para expresar la condición o conclusión inevitable de una situación.
Todas las inferencias sobre el pasado requieren la estructura modal + have + participio.

tip.label: Práctica:
tip.body: escribe una frase personal con el patrón.

quiz.q: The management team ___ known about the flaw; otherwise, they would have halted distribution.
quiz.explain: 'Can't have + participio' expresa la imposibilidad lógica de un evento pasado.

quiz.q: Considering our rapid growth, we ___ need to recruit additional engineers soon.
quiz.explain: 'May well' indica una alta probabilidad en el presente/futuro.

quiz.q: ¿Qué opción expresa una inferencia lógica afirmativa fundamentada en evidencia pasada?
options: The server logs show thousands of requests; we must have suffered a DDoS attack.
The server logs show thousands of requests; we can have suffered a DDoS attack.
The server logs show thousands of requests; we would suffer a DDoS attack.
The server logs show thousands of requests; we may to suffer a DDoS attack.
quiz.explain: 'Must have + participio' es la forma para conclusiones afirmativas de alta certeza sobre el pasado.
